### Commit to the Lord
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/commit-to-the-lord
Passage: Proverbs 16:3
Points:
- Proper Christian vocation balances diligent effort with relying on God's direction.
- Work performed without regard for God brings no lasting fulfillment or eternal honor.
- Committing our endeavors to the Lord requires humble faith and continuous prayer.
- Genuine peace and true success are found only in submission to Christ's lordship.

### Trusting God's Will Over Our Way
Author: Alexandra Hoover
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-8-2021.html
Passage: Proverbs 16:3
Points:
- Pursuing personal career ambitions apart from God's guidance leads to spiritual exhaustion.
- Biblical commitment means rolling our desires and heavy burdens over to Jesus.
- Solomon's eventual downfall shows the danger of withholding complete obedience from God.
- Surrendering our tightly held plans allows God to align our hearts with His best path.

### A Prayer for When Things Don't Go as Planned
Author: Kristine Brown
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-when-things-dont-go-as-planned.html
Passage: Proverbs 16:9
Points:
- Goal-setting is a good gift, yet unforeseen hardships often disrupt our expectations.
- Even when circumstances change drastically, God provides unexpected gifts along the way.
- The path the Lord establishes may involve trials, but His presence and promises remain sure.
- Believers can actively thank God and trust His sovereign authorship of their life story.

### Learning to Roll with It
Author: Elisa Pulliam
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-october-5-2018.html
Passage: Proverbs 16:9
Points:
- Human plans regularly meet unanticipated obstacles and divine interruptions.
- Growing in the knowledge of God's character enables believers to respond to disruption with grace.
- Rerouted schedules often position us to serve others in ways we could not anticipate.
- Letting go of rigid expectations allows the Spirit to smooth our stubbornness and lead us.
